occlusion_limit: This is a single elevated front-left view; it does not expose all surfaces or hidden contacts. Far-side hinges/interior remain partially occluded.
diagnostic_quality: Accepted for native saved-control endpoint illustration, not a detailed material, interference, or photorealistic acceptance image.
